name: io.github.tonyyang0504/taobao_fenxiao_alimama-mcp
description: Taobao/Tmall distribution (淘宝分销 → Tmall 供销平台) + Taobao Affiliate (淘宝联盟) (ecommerce suppliers): me, l

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_FENXIAO_ALIMAMA_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AppKey of your Taobao Open Platform (TOP) application (open.taobao.com console).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_FENXIAO_ALIMAMA_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: AppSecret of the same application; signs every call as upper-case MD5(secret + parameters sorted by name as name+value + secret) and is never sent.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_FENXIAO_ALIMAMA_ADZONE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Promotion slot id: the last number of your 淘宝联盟 PID mm_xxx_xxx_<adzone_id> (pub.alimama.com > 推广管理 > 推广位管理).
